items:
~ WHY YOU WILL LOVE "BELLA VITA" ~
• Beach entrance is across from from the driveway!
• Enjoy private beach access which is not crowded like the public beaches
• 2 Master suites & all 6 bedrooms have their own private bathrooms
• Carriage House included & lower level studio apartment included
• Walking distance to the best restaurant around - Stinky's Fish Camp
• Just 1 mile from 2 gas stations & Gulf Place town square full of restaurants and shops
• 7 minutes to Grand Boulevard outdoor shopping center full of great stores, restaurants and a movie theater
• 10 minutes to Silver Sands Outlet Mall in Miramar Beach

~ THE SPACE ~
"Bella Vita" at the beach is a beautiful spacious home just steps from the white sand. Enjoy the peace and quiet of a private community beach, no need to fight for a spot at 7am on the crowded public beaches. Family friendly beach equipment is at your disposal. Take the Tommy Bahama back pack beach chairs, load up the wagon with snack and drinks and take a hop, skip and jump to the beach entrance conveniently located at the end of the driveway and get ready to pop up the umbrella and relax. "Bella Vita" at the beach is a returning guest favorite because there is no boardwalk or flights of stairs to get to the ocean like most beach access points. This home offers a straight walk through the sand right to the waters edge. Not only is the beach proximity exceptional but it has 2 master suites and all 6 bedrooms have their own private attached bathroom, literally a vacationers dream!

"Bella Vita" features a Grand Porch offering endless sunsets, summer breezes and sunrises! It is spacious, bright, beachy and the perfect beach luxury vacation getaway for your family! A beautiful coastal decor offers tranquility and peace at the end of each day The great room is an open concept living room and dining area. The living room has a large flat screen smart tv, satellite cable, and wifi. Enjoy dinners in at the elegant dining table with seating for 8. The kitchen is freshly outfitted with stainless steel appliances and beautiful dark quartz countertops with a breakfast nook for additional seating. It is fully stocked with a toaster oven, crock pot, blender, Keurig Duo, glassware, dishes, flatware and pots and pans galore.

Just off the main living space are 4 spacious bedrooms suites. The 2 master suites have king beds, flat screen tvs with satellite cable, and their own private bathrooms. West of the foyer is a guest suite with two queen beds, a flat screen tv with satellite cable, and a private attached bathroom. East of the foyer is the kids guest suite with two twin over twin bunk bed sets (4 twin beds total) a flat screen tv with satellite cable, and a private attached bathroom with a bathtub if needed for the little ones. Off from the back deck is the carriage house with a queen bed perfect for a family member who desires a little extra privacy. Featuring an open concept floor plan, this room offers a sitting area with couch and chairs, a flat screen tv with satellite cable, a dining area with seating for 4, a kitchenette with a compact refrigerator and coffee maker. The attached bathroom was just remodeled with a custom tile shower. The lower level studio apartment has private exterior access and it features a brand new queen bed, new furniture, bistro set with seating for 2, a kitchenette with mini fridge, and an attached bathroom with a shower.

* Room Details *
*Must walk up 1 flight of stairs to get to the main floor, carriage house is accessible from this floor without any additional stairs.
Master Suite (East): king bed, private bathroom with shower/tub combo (main floor)
Master Suite (West): king bed, private bathroom with shower/tub combo (main floor)
Guest Suite: 2 queen beds, private bathroom with shower/tub combo (main floor)
Guest Suite: 2 twin over twin bunk bed sets (4 twin beds), private bathroom with shower/tub combo (main floor)
Carriage House Guest Suite: *off back deck, queen bed, private bathroom with shower, sitting area, dining area with kitchenette (main floor)
Studio Apartment Guest Suite: *exterior of main home and down 4 steps to the lower level, queen bed, private bathroom with shower, small dining area with kitchenette (lower floor)

* Amenity Details *
Private Beach Access: directly across the street.
Beach Rules: No tents, canopies or umbrellas with sides. No umbrellas larger than 7 ft in diameter.
This beach does not allow beach service. All items must be brought in every evening.
Provided Beach Equipment: 6 beach chairs, 1 wagon, 2 umbrellas

* Special Attention Rules *
ON-SITE 24-hour HOA Homeowners Association Manager
NO pets, smoking, parties or events
Must be 30+ to book | NO college spring break groups | Family-style rentals only
Maximum of 4 vehicles permitted in the front gravel parking spaces only
If a golf cart is rented, it counts as one parking space, reducing vehicle parking to 3 total
Property is equipped with exterior security monitoring
Driveway use is prohibited and blocked off
Mailbox is not for guest use

~ WHY YOU WILL LOVE THE AREA ~
"Bella Vita" is just a little over a mile away from Gulf Place town center. This area is lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, eclectic beach bars, world-class restaurants, and 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Stop by Perfect Pig for mouth watering food any time of day, sneak in a lunch or dinner at Stinky's Fish Camp or watch the dolphins from the second story of the the Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar. Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. "Bella Vita" is located near many beach access points if you want to try a public beach instead of the private beach. This includes Fort Panic beach access, Dune Allen Regional beach access, West Allen Loop beach access, and even Ed Walline regional beach access where you can walk across the street to Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar and grab a meal and drink to go and sit on the beach with fabulous food and a breathtaking view. The Villages of 30-A Include Dune Allen, Santa Rosa Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor Seaside, Seagrove, Watersound, Alys Beach, Seacrest, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.

Located in Dune Allen Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is near a water park and on the beach. While the natural beauty of Santa Rosa Beach and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sirens at the Beach and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.

reviews.text:
The location could not have been better. The beach access is right across the driveway, making it incredibly easy to walk back and forth throughout the day even for the older crowd. It was so convenient to run back for lunch, grab something we forgot, or take a break from the sun.

The house itself was very clean and very well stocked. We especially enjoyed relaxing on the porch in the evenings. We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely book Bella Vita again for our next trip to 30A.
